# Elounda Traditional Homes of Crete

> Official website of Elounda Traditional Homes of Crete, offering restored traditional houses in Mavrikiano above Elounda and a villa in Vrouchas, East Crete, Greece.

The website provides official accommodation descriptions, location information, practical village guides, and researched articles about Elounda and Mirabello Bay. Availability, prices, and booking conditions may change; consult the booking and contact pages for current information.

## Accommodation

- [Home](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/): Overview of Elounda Traditional Homes of Crete.
- [Traditional houses](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/houses/): Collection of traditional houses in Mavrikiano.
- [Almond Tree Villa](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/villa/almond-tree-villa/): Villa accommodation in Vrouchas.
- [Contact](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/contact/): Official contact and enquiry form.
- [Policies](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/policies/): Booking and accommodation policies.

## Location and practical guides

- [Location](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/location/): Location, maps, distances, and the two accommodation areas.
- [Mavrikiano guide](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/guide/mavrikiano/): Practical information about Mavrikiano.
- [Vrouchas guide](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/guide/vrouchas/): Practical information about Vrouchas.
- [Frequently asked questions](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/faq/): Common questions about the properties and stays.

## Elounda and Mirabello Bay

- [Blog](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/blog/): Articles about Elounda, East Crete, history, landscapes, and local life.
- [Elounda and Mirabello Bay](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/blog/elounda-and-mirabello-bay/): Geographic orientation to Elounda and Mirabello Bay.
- [Elounda beaches](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/blog/elounda-beaches/): Practical guide to Schisma, Chiona, Kolokytha, Plaka and the distinctions between public beaches and hotel-managed sectors.
- [Walking around Elounda](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/blog/walking-around-elounda/): Walking landscapes, route conditions, and practical safety.
- [Elounda history through its shoreline](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/blog/elounda-history-through-its-shoreline/): Historical overview of the Elounda coastline.
- [Elounda salt pans and Poros windmills](https://traditional-homes.gr/en/blog/elounda-salt-pans-and-poros-windmills/): History of the salt pans and windmills.
